author: Michael Larabel
description: Happening back in Linux 7.1 was the "NTFS resurrection" with landing a new NTFS driver into the Linux kernel that had been years in the making and began as the former NTFS read-only kernel driver many years back before the stint of the Paragon NTFS3 driver in the Linux kernel. For Linux 7.2 that new/modern NTFS driver has seen more hardening work, some fixes, and Windows native symbolic links support...
title: New NTFS Driver Sees Hardening & Fixes, Windows Native Symlinks With Linux 7.2

author: Michael Larabel
description: With the code merged today to Mesa 26.2-devel, the open-source NVIDIA "NVK" Vulkan driver is capable of handling Deep Learning Super Sampling (DLSS) with modern game titles running on Linux / Steam Play...
title: Open-Source NVIDIA NVK Vulkan Driver Now Supports DLSS

author: Michael Larabel
description: Barco, the Europeean technology company that manufactures the AMD GPU based MXRT graphics cards for for multi-display medical imaging systems (and also MXRV for their NVIDIA based graphics cards), have to date only seen Windows drivers published for their professional-grade graphics cards even with using Radeon Pro derived GPUs. But a patch published today to the AMD graphics mailing list is opening the door for Linux support...
title: AMD-Powered Barco MXRT Graphics Cards Finally Seeing Linux Driver Support

author: Michael Larabel
description: Systemd 261 is out as stable today with a number of new features and ready to coincide with H2'2026 Linux distributions...
title: systemd 261 Released With New systemd-sysinstall OS Installer, IMDSD & Storagectl

author: Michael Larabel
description: It looks like AMD's next-gen SoCs not only will be exciting on the CPU side with the much anticipated Zen 6 cores but the AMD Audio Co-Processor "ACP" IP looks to be going through some significant updates...
title: AMD ACP7.D/7.E/7.F Driver Added In Linux 7.2: "Substantial Design Changes" For AMD Audio

author: Michael Larabel
description: The networking subsystem changes have been merged for Linux 7.2 with a lot happening around the core networking code as well as the many wired and wireless networking device drivers...
title: Linux 7.2 Brings More Work Around WiFi Aware, WiFi 8 / UHR & More Networking Hardware

author: Michael Larabel
description: Raspberry Pi engineers have released their first update to Raspberry Pi OS since April. With this new version comes the upgrade to the latest Linux 6.18 LTS kernel...
title: Raspberry Pi OS Moves To Linux 6.18 LTS Kernel, Updated LabWC Compositor

author: Michael Larabel
description: Just shy of 1,000 new patches were merged on the SoC side for the Linux 7.2 kernel. Among all those patches are enabling five more SoCs to work with the mainline Linux kernel -- including the long-awaited Apple M3 support...
title: Apple M3 Booting On Linux After Three Years Plus Other SoC Updates In Linux 7.2

author: Michael Larabel
description: Just days after AMD engineers released a new Lemonade AI server with MCP server integration to make it much more useful, they have now released a new release of their GAIA "Generative AI Is Awesome" open-source software. With AMD GAIA 0.21.2, they have introduced a bash coding agent is their latest big ticket item in the AI space...
title: AMD Introduces An AI-Powered Bash Coding Agent

author: Michael Larabel
description: For those interested in Trust Domain Extensions (TDX) with modern Intel Xeon processors for confidential computing but also view system uptime as critical, beginning in Linux 7.2 the TDX support is now much more practical with allowing live updates without the need to reboot the running system in the event of security updates and similar...
title: Intel TDX Now Much More Practical With Ability To Apply Important Updates Without Reboot

author: Michael Larabel
description: For those that enjoy keeping an eye on all their system vitals from temperatures to voltages, the hardware monitoring "HWMON" updates have seen many device additions for Linux 7.2...
title: ARCTIC Fan Controller, More ASUS & ASRock Boards Have Sensor Monitoring With Linux 7.2
